newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q4 industrial production rises 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q4 industrial production rises 3.0 pct.

text.p: Swiss industrial production rose 10 percent in the fourth quarter from the third for a year-on-year increase of three percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
NOTE - The office said the figures showed a reversal in the negative trend seen since the start of 1996.

The figures, which exclude construction, show a marked increase in output from the chemical industry, while there was a drop in output from the wood-working, watch, machinery, vehicle, electrical and leather/shoe industries.
